scripts.backend:dev: uv run --project backend uvicorn lifegoods.main:app --app-dir backend/src --reload
scripts.backend:lint: uv run --project backend ruff check backend/src backend/tests backend/scripts backend/migrations
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.off:dataset: PYTHONPATH=backend/src uv run --project backend python -m lifegoods.open_food_facts.cli --mongo-uri mongodb://lifegoods_writer:lifegoods_writer@localhost:27018/lifegoods_off
scripts.api:generate: uv run --project backend python backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir frontend api:generate
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/openapi.json frontend/src/api/generated
